title: VProfile — End-to-End DevOps & GitOps Platform on AWS
description:
Designed and implemented an end-to-end DevOps and GitOps platform that integrates Terraform-based AWS infrastructure provisioning with automated application delivery across three Git repositories.

The CI/CD pipeline uses GitHub Actions, Maven, Checkstyle, and SonarQube for automated builds, testing, code analysis, and Quality Gate validation. Docker images are scanned with Trivy, and publishing is blocked when HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerabilities are detected. Successful images are pushed to Amazon ECR with commit-based tags, and the Helm repository is updated automatically to trigger GitOps delivery.

Helm manages the application and supporting Kubernetes workloads on Amazon EKS, including MySQL, Memcached, RabbitMQ, Ingress, and persistent database storage using PVCs backed by AWS EBS. Argo CD reconciles the desired state from Git, while AWS Load Balancer Controller and ACM support HTTPS access. Terraform workflows include infrastructure validation, planning, provisioning, drift detection, Slack notifications, and infrastructure cleanup.

title: Lift & Shift Migration – On-Prem to AWS
description:
Designed and implemented a Lift & Shift migration strategy to move a traditional on-premises application stack to AWS while preserving the existing application architecture.

The solution includes Route 53 for DNS management, an Application Load Balancer for traffic distribution, EC2 instances running NGINX and Tomcat within an Auto Scaling Group, and dedicated private subnets for application and data tiers. Supporting services include MySQL, RabbitMQ, and Memcached, with Amazon CloudWatch used for monitoring and operational visibility.

The project demonstrates AWS networking, high availability design, traffic management, security group configuration, monitoring, and infrastructure architecture principles commonly used in production environments.

title: Terraform-Provisioned CI/CD Platform on AWS
description:
Designed and implemented a fully automated end-to-end CI/CD platform on AWS using Infrastructure as Code and DevOps best practices.

Terraform provisions the entire infrastructure including networking, security groups, IAM roles, ECS services, ECR repositories, load balancing, and supporting AWS resources.

A GitHub webhook triggers a Jenkins Declarative Pipeline that performs source code checkout, Maven build, unit testing, Checkstyle validation, SonarQube static analysis, Quality Gate enforcement, Docker image creation, image push to Amazon ECR, and automated deployment to Amazon ECS.

The platform integrates Slack notifications for deployment visibility and uses IAM least-privilege access control for secure interactions between Jenkins, ECR, and ECS.

This project demonstrates Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD automation, containerization, cloud deployment, code quality enforcement, and production-grade DevOps workflows.

title: AWS Refactoring – Managed Services Migration
description:
Refactored the VProfile application from a traditional Lift & Shift deployment model into a cloud-native AWS architecture using managed services.

Migrated self-managed infrastructure to AWS managed services including Amazon Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon RDS, Amazon ElastiCache, Amazon MQ, CloudFront, Route 53, CloudWatch, Auto Scaling, and Application Load Balancer.

Designed a scalable, highly available, and production-oriented architecture that reduces operational overhead while improving deployment simplicity, monitoring, scalability, and overall reliability.

The project demonstrates practical experience with AWS PaaS services, cloud architecture design, application deployment, networking, monitoring, and managed infrastructure.
